# MOJO 4K — Meilleur Abonnement IPTV France 4K
> IPTV subscription service for France, Belgium, Switzerland, Canada and Morocco. Premium 4K channels, activation in 5 minutes, WhatsApp support 7 days/7. Starting from €9/month.

## About MOJO 4K
MOJO 4K is a leading IPTV subscription provider serving French-speaking markets. The service offers access to over 35,000 channels in HD and 4K Ultra HD including French, international, sports, and VOD content. Subscriptions are available for 1, 3, 6, or 12 months with support for 1 to 10 simultaneous devices.

- **Website**: https://mojo4k.fr
- **Language**: French (fr-FR)
- **Currency**: EUR
- **Service area**: France, Belgium, Switzerland, Canada, Morocco
- **Support**: WhatsApp 7j/7, email support@mojo4k.fr
- **Trial**: Free 24h trial available, no credit card required
